MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN DATE('2026-10-14') ELSE CAST(STRPTIME(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE) END AS end_date
WITH p,
  DATE_DIFF('year', birth_date, end_date) - CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', end_date) * 100 + DATE_PART('day', end_date) < DATE_PART('month', birth_date) * 100 + DATE_PART('day', birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
